description: Nudge items by the keyboard increment, or step their scale or size by 1% or 5%, as the arrow keys and scale shortcuts do (Preferences > Units & Increments > Cursor Key; Object Editing shortcuts)

action.description: Nudge in a direction; scale frame and content up or down; or resize the frame up or down

referencePoint.description: Reference point on the bounding box that stays fixed (the reference point proxy); default center

step.description: Nudge: the cursor key increment, a tenth of it, or ten times it. Scale and size: normal 1%, coarse 5%. Default normal

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_page_items, or the id a create tool returns), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

name: nudge_items
title: Nudge Items
